capabilities.title: Run a model task
capabilities.description: Run the submitted text using captured model settings and the original native controller. Retains the native Operation until the model and dispatched native tools settle and records text and usage in its original task. An optional exact R binding permits bounded observation in Explain and execution only in Run, subject to original scopes and granted native capabilities. Attachments and continuation are not yet composed. Identical original requests only observe the existing run.
